guides.title: Getting started with NUSI
guides.tagline: Create your practice, set it up in three quick steps, and get your first clients into NUSI.

guides.title: Your dashboard (Overview)
guides.tagline: The first screen you see each day: how your practice is doing, who needs you, what is coming up, and how much of your plan you have used.

guides.title: Clients: adding and managing your roster
guides.tagline: Add clients four different ways, approve people who join through your link, and check on anyone at a glance without leaving the list.

guides.title: A client's profile
guides.tagline: Everything about one client in one place: health profile, meals, measurements, labs, assessments, files, private notes and their complete record as a PDF.

guides.title: Programs
guides.tagline: Build a program once (for example "90-day Diabetes Reversal"), give it to many clients, and track how well each one follows it.

guides.title: Meal plans
guides.tagline: Create a weekly meal plan for each client, with your own meal times, accurate nutrition from the food library or AI, and a branded PDF to share.

guides.title: Assessments
guides.tagline: Build questionnaires or use ready-made templates, send them to clients, and review their answers in one inbox.

guides.title: Appointments & video calls
guides.tagline: Set your booking hours, schedule sessions, approve client requests and hold video calls right inside NUSI.

guides.title: Messaging & Team chat
guides.tagline: Chat one-to-one with clients (text, photos, files and voice notes), and talk privately with your team.

guides.title: Plate Vision & meal review
guides.tagline: Clients photograph their meals, NUSI's AI estimates the nutrients, and you approve, adjust or flag each one.

guides.title: Nutrition library & recipes
guides.tagline: Search thousands of Indian and international foods, add your own, and build recipes with full nutrition.

guides.title: Community & your public page
guides.tagline: Give your clients a space to share wins and support each other, connect with other nutritionists, and get a public page for new clients.

guides.title: Your team
guides.tagline: Invite nutritionists, coaches and front-desk staff, decide what each person can do, and give coaches their own caseload.

guides.title: Billing & plans
guides.tagline: Choose or change your plan, pay securely, buy extra AI credits, download GST invoices and cancel when you need to.

guides.title: Reports & Analytics
guides.tagline: Create polished PDF reports for a client, a program or your whole practice, and see how your practice is growing.

guides.title: Settings
guides.tagline: Your practice details, public page, verification, WhatsApp, AI, video calls, notifications, security and data, all in one place.

guides.title: What your clients see (the NUSI app)
guides.tagline: How clients join your practice, log their meals with a photo, follow their plan, answer forms, book sessions and chat with you.
